name: Arcade
alt: Arcade menu on the round screen
pitch: Turn to choose a game, tap to play and hold the screen to return.
banner: a glowing round arcade gadget like a tiny cabinet, a ring of six miniature game worlds orbiting its circular screen, neon tokens and joystick sparks

name: Theremin
alt: Theremin playing 220 Hz
pitch: Slide a finger around the screen to play. Angle sets pitch, distance sets volume and the bezel changes waveform.

name: Safe Cracker
alt: Safe dial with a number locked in
pitch: Turn and tap to lock in a three-number combination before time runs out.
banner: a chunky cartoon bank-vault dial glowing on a round gadget, a stethoscope listening at the dial, gold bars peeking from a door swinging open

name: Do This!
alt: The screen calling for a left spin
pitch: Follow the prompt before the rim runs out.

name: Mainframe
alt: A green terminal with hex raining down and an amber trace arc around the rim
pitch: Crack a six-character password one slot at a time, guided by a hot and cold bar, before the trace fills the rim.
banner: a round gadget glowing green in a dark server room, cascading green hex digits raining past, a cartoon hacker hood and ACCESS GRANTED light beams

name: Pickpocket
alt: A big cartoon eye wide open and HEY! in red
pitch: Turn your hand round the rim to the swaying pocket and tap to lift the wallet, but only while the eye is shut.
banner: a cartoon gloved hand sneaking towards a wallet poking out of a swaying coat pocket, a giant cartoon eye peeking from a round gadget's screen

name: Getaway
alt: A ring road with a blue police car and an orange getaway car
pitch: Switch lanes round a ring road to dodge the police. Every ten cars you pass, it gets faster.
banner: a tiny cartoon getaway car racing round a circular ring road on a gadget's glowing screen, police cars with red and blue lights chasing

name: Pocket Pet
alt: A happy round virtual pet
pitch: Tap to feed your pet or spin to play as food, fun and sleep drain around the rim.

name: Tap Reflex
alt: Tap Reflex showing the green signal
pitch: Wait for green, tap and see how close you came to your best time.
banner: a round gadget flashing bright green, a cartoon finger blurring towards it, a stopwatch exploding into speed lines

name: Dice Roller
alt: Four dice settled on the screen
pitch: Roll up to four dice with slowing clicks and haptic ticks.
banner: four chunky glowing dice tumbling out of a round gadget's screen onto a board-game table, pips trailing light

name: Kitchen Timer
alt: Kitchen timer with half of the countdown arc left
pitch: Turn to set the minutes and tap to start. Three beeps mark zero.
banner: a round gadget perched on a kitchen counter beside a steaming pot, a glowing orange arc draining around its rim, an egg and a whisk

name: Metronome
alt: Metronome with its beat indicator lit
pitch: Turn the bezel to set the tempo. Hear and feel each beat, with an accent on the first.
banner: a round gadget swinging a glowing pendulum like a metronome, musical notes bouncing in time, sheet music fanned behind

name: Dial Synth
alt: Dial Synth with its circular note display
pitch: Turn through a pentatonic scale and tap to play a chord.
banner: a round gadget whose bezel is a glowing ring of piano keys, colourful notes spiralling out of its screen like a synth wave

name: Rim Pong
alt: Rim Pong just after a serve
pitch: Keep the ball inside the circle with a paddle that moves around the rim.
banner: a glowing ball bouncing inside a round screen, a curved paddle hugging the rim, retro arcade sparks and a scoreboard

name: Pocket Synth
alt: Pocket Synth with eight rainbow keys mirrored around D4 in left-handed mode
pitch: Touch-audition synth with four patches, bezel volume, left-handed piano mirror around D4 and a MIDI input hook.

name: MIDI Bridge
alt: MIDI Bridge showing M-VAVE FM-1 connected, LH ON and C4 -> E4
pitch: Wireless dual-BLE Left-Handed Piano bridge between SMK-37 Pro and FM-1 with a live 37-key colour-paired keyboard, lockable piano mirror axes and Wi-Fi OTA.

name: Gap Finder
alt: Gap Finder showing a correct m3 interval answer and weakest interval footer
pitch: Ear-training interval game: hear two notes, turn the bezel to name the interval, and track your weakest interval.

name: Piano Coach
alt: Piano Coach showing D, 375 ms, LH chip and gold-ringed TAP disc
pitch: Note-name Quick Draw with drawn sharp and flat signs, slowest-notes list, Rhythm timing mode and left/right touch layout.

name: Staff Sight
alt: Staff Sight showing a treble staff note, 263 ms and LH layout
pitch: Sight-reading trainer on treble, bass or grand staves with unlockable ledger lines and left/right touch layout.

name: Echo Keys
alt: Echo Keys with a 12-semitone chromatic strip on the right and D lit yellow
pitch: Simon on a piano: hear a growing phrase light the LED ring and repeat it on a flippable left/right chromatic strip.

name: Chord Spotter
alt: Chord Spotter showing a 3x4 chromatic pad grid on the left with D major notes ringed gold
pitch: Spot and play triads and sevenths with green heard tones, gold missing notes, red wrong thirds and left/right pad layout.

name: Tally Counter
alt: Tally Counter showing 10 with one green rim segment filled
pitch: Turn to count up or down with haptic ticks, a rising chime and rim segment every ten, and a 1-second hold to reset.

name: Colour Mixer
alt: Colour Mixer showing a 36-segment rainbow ring, #FFD400 disc and saved swatches
pitch: Turn through a 36-segment colour wheel, drag for brightness, read the hex code and save up to four swatches.

name: Magic Eight
alt: Magic Eight ball triangle revealing 'very unlikely'
pitch: Flick the knob or tap to shake, feel the haptic rumble and bubbling sounds, and watch one of twenty fortunes fade in.

name: Breathing Guide
alt: Breathing Guide showing the expanded calm breathing disc at hold
pitch: A calm box-breathing disc that grows, holds and shrinks with soft haptic bumps, rising tones and bezel-set cycle length.

name: Whack-a-Mole
alt: Whack-a-Mole with eight ring holes, a centre hole and a brown mole popped up
pitch: Tap popping moles around eight rim holes and the centre before they duck away and cost one of three lives.

name: Copy Cat
alt: Copy Cat showing a cyan left chevron, ROUND 1 WATCH and CLICK L
pitch: Watch a growing sequence of clicks, spins and taps light the screen and LED ring, then repeat it back from memory.

name: Simon
alt: Simon with four coloured quadrants, the yellow quadrant lit and ROUND 1 in the centre
pitch: Four coloured quadrants light up and play their own tones in a growing sequence; tap them back without a mistake.

name: Pitch Match
alt: Pitch Match showing a circular chromatic tuning dial with Tune it! and Round 1 / 5
pitch: Hear a target tone, turn the knob to tune your own pitch by ear, tap to lock in and see how many cents off you were.

name: Higher or Lower
alt: Higher or Lower showing 31, YOU GOT IT! and 1 guesses
pitch: Turn the knob to guess a secret number from 1 to 100, tap to submit, and follow the higher or lower hints.

name: Quick Draw
alt: Quick Draw showing knob player wins! with reaction time and score
pitch: Two-player standoff on one knob: wait for DRAW, then race to spin the bezel or tap the screen first.

name: Stop the Sweep
alt: Stop the Sweep showing a concentric sweep dial with a scored hit
pitch: A marker sweeps round the rim through a shrinking target zone; tap at the right instant to score and chase your best.

name: Lock Pick
alt: Lock Pick showing the radial tumbler dial with the pick marker glowing near the sweet spot
pitch: Feel your way round a radial tumbler dial as colour and haptics warm near the sweet spot, then tap before your picks run out.

name: Tug of War
alt: Tug of War showing the rope, goal posts and flag pulled towards the knob side
pitch: Two-player battle on one knob: one player taps the screen to pull left while the other spins the bezel to pull right.

name: Hot Potato
alt: Hot Potato showing the warming crimson dial and potato face with HOLD ON...
pitch: Pass the knob round the table while the screen warms toward crimson and ticks faster until it blows.

name: Redline
alt: Redline tachometer showing the needle in the green band at LV 2 LEVEL UP
pitch: Spin the bezel to hold the tachometer needle inside the green rev band without stalling or hitting the redline.

name: Snail Race
alt: Snail Race showing red, yellow and blue snails with eye-stalks racing along three curved lanes toward a checkered finish line
pitch: Spin the bezel to squelch your snail forward along three curved lanes and beat two rivals to the checkered line.

name: Key Speed
alt: Key Speed showing a correct key
pitch: Light up the right notes fast: rhythm and practice modes for a 12-key strip.
banner: a glowing round gadget with a 12-key piano strip lighting up in time like a rhythm game, sparks and glow

name: Chord Mirror
alt: Chord Mirror showing a held chord
pitch: Play chords on the SMK-37 Pro and watch them mirrored back on the FM-1.
banner: a glowing round gadget with two tiny music keyboards mirroring each other, chord notes glowing in gold

name: Scale Lock
alt: Scale Lock snapping to a major scale
pitch: Hear notes while the knob cycles the scale; the FM-1 locks to the right notes.
banner: a round gadget glowing with a pentatonic dial and a glowing string of notes being trapped into a scale

name: Arpeggiator
alt: Arpeggiator cycling chord notes
pitch: Turn the knob to set the BPM and watch the arpeggio loop play a chord on the FM-1.
banner: a round gadget with a weaving dot circling its rim like a metronome, musical notes spiralling out

name: Octave Jumper
alt: Octave Jumper showing a matching pitch class
pitch: Hear a random melody and jump an octave to make the pitch class match.
banner: a round gadget with two glowing piano-key strips and an arrow carrying one note up an octave

name: Velocity Meter
alt: Velocity Meter showing velocity bars
pitch: Play on the SMK-37 Pro and watch per-note velocity bars light up.
banner: a round gadget with a bar-graph of colourful bars rising like a tiny equaliser, glowing notes

name: Drone Pad
alt: Drone Pad playing a held chord
pitch: Hold a chord on the keyboard and the FM-1 drone plays it while the knob slides the pitch.
banner: a round gadget resting a single chord as a glowing static-filled halo

name: Rhythm Tap
alt: Rhythm Tap with a tapped ring
pitch: Tap on the shrinking ring to score; knob sets the tempo.
banner: a round gadget with a glowing shrinking ring and a cartoon finger flicking towards it

name: Pomodoro Dial
alt: Pomodoro Dial mid-countdown
pitch: Pick a length with the knob, tap to start; a tick ring drains around the rim.
banner: a cartoon tomato with a glowing arc draining around it like a pomodoro timer

name: Tea Steeper
alt: Tea Steeper running
pitch: Pick a blend with the knob; tap to start a steep; long-press for strength.
banner: a steaming tea cup glowing on a round gadget, bubbles rising in a glowing cup

name: Compass Spinner
alt: Compass Spinner settled north
pitch: Flick the needle with the knob; it settles to north with a reading.
banner: a glowing compass needle sweeping inside a round gadget like a tiny ship's compass

name: Coin Flip
alt: Coin Flip mid-toss
pitch: Tap to toss a wobbling coin; knob changes the toss speed.
banner: a glowing cartoon coin spinnning mid-air over a round gadget, sparkle particles

name: Bubble Level
alt: Bubble Level showing LEVEL
pitch: Roll the bubble with the knob; level and it chimes.
banner: a tiny green bubble sitting dead-centre in a glowing tube on a round gadget

name: Orbit Dodge
alt: Orbit Dodge showing the rim
pitch: Spin the player dot around the rim to dodge asteroids.
banner: a glowing dot orbiting a ring on a round gadget, tiny asteroids falling in from the rim

name: Asteroid Cannon
alt: Asteroid Cannon firing
pitch: Spin the barrel with the knob, tap to fire, and blast asteroids.
banner: a glowing cannon barrel pointing up inside a round gadget, tiny asteroids tumbling past

name: Colour Match
alt: Colour Match with the needle turned
pitch: Spin the hue dial to match the target colour.
banner: a glowing colour wheel on a round gadget with a white needle pointing at a bright hue

name: Memory Dial
alt: Memory Dial showing the lit wedge
pitch: Watch the lit wedge, then tap it back.
banner: a glowing 12-segment dial with one bright wedge on a round gadget

name: Safe Heat
alt: Safe Heat with a dial picked
pitch: Rotate the dial to pick three digits; tap to enter.
banner: a glowing safe dial inside a round gadget, a cartoon lock glowing amber

name: Sound Board
alt: Sound Board playing a pad
pitch: Tap a pad for a sound; knob sets the volume.
banner: a round gadget with six glowing coloured pads and musical notes bouncing off its rim

name: Morse Trainer
alt: Morse Trainer showing a dash
pitch: Tap (dot) and long-press (dash) to enter a letter's Morse code.
banner: a round gadget showing a glowing Morse code string of dots and dashes

name: Starfield
alt: Starfield Screensaver warping
pitch: Knob sets the warp speed; tap to jolt the starfield.
banner: a glowing starfield warping across a round gadget like a tiny night sky
